handback.summary: Docs now say repo secrets; the setup audit reports each key missing from the repo secrets, reading names only.

criteria.ask: `README.md` and `docs/wiki/Installing.md` say repo secrets; `dokima/audit.py` lists repo secret names, needing new app permission `secrets: read`.

handback.evidence: `pytest -q` on audit, manifest, app, docs and install tests: 160 passed.

raises.label: Workflows still say environment
raises.text: Workflow error messages still tell adopters to put missing keys in the keys environment, which never reaches their jobs.
raises.evidence: `.github/workflows/agent.yml` lines 138 and 162; workflows are outside a worker's reach.

raises.label: Own repo will flag
raises.text: This repo keeps its keys in the keys environment, so its own audit will now report them missing until they are repo secrets too.
